shots.picture: **FRAME 0.** The glass door, the blind **up**. Don at the left cord (three-quarter back), the robot at the right cord. Don's hand pulls: the slats rattle down, the room darkens; **☀** lights on the robot's visor and its hand pulls them up. Down, up, down, up, each faster
The whole blind tears off its rail and drops over Don. Pam, Mom and Sofía mid-room by the counter's end, where the tape will run
Don under the blind, only his face out. The bare glass behind him. The robot's ☀ fades to a smile
Don, the blind over his shoulders like a cape, the tape roll on his wrist. Pam, Mom and Sofía behind him
shots.line: DON: "My father has a meeting. Without me."

shots.picture: Floor level. **The tape rips across the floor toward the camera, straight through the group**: three pairs of feet hop apart (Pam's flats left, Sofía's heels right, Mom's shoes stay on it)
Don passes the throne; its **$49,999** price tag (from 12) swings at the crown. He sees it, and spins the throne so the tag faces the wall
Don stamps on his half, the roll pointed at each of them in turn like a weapon. On the tape: **DON** and an arrow
**Pam** steps over to Don first, quickly. **Her phone stays on the counter, across the line** (face up, dark)
Don and Pam. He **salutes** her, solemn; she half returns it with her cup hand, then hides a small smile in the cup
**Mom** plants both feet on the tape; arms folded; she looks at Don
**Sofía** steps toward Don and stops mid-step
**The heel:** her black shoe, heel planted behind the tape, toe on Don's side. Held
The robot, at its station. Its visor: a small **barrier with a red light**

Don admiring his line, not listening. The robot rolls onto the tape and **balances on it**, its one wheel on the line, arms out like a tightrope walker (Tomas, robot sheet /grill-me). After "Both.", **0.4 s on Don's face**
Don pushes it off onto his side; it rolls back onto the tape (1.4 s). Again, quicker (1.0 s). Third push: it comes back at once and **bumps Don**, who has stepped into its path (0.6 s + the stagger)
Sofía, the heel still back: she **folds her arms** and gives Don one flat look
Its arm **telescopes** up out of its side, a phone clamped at the tip. Don swings into his big pose

A camera FLASH (a real flash, lesson 114), then **the photo fills the screen**, rendered from this beat's own wide: Don beaming, Pam beside him, Mom on the tape, the robot balancing on the tape, **Sofía's heel behind the line**, and **a big silhouette behind the door's glass**
The robot turns the phone at the tip of its arm to Don: the photo with **PUBLIC POST?** over it (and on its visor)
Don, still posing, eyes on his own reflection, thumb on the robot's pad without looking
PUBLIC POST? slides up and away; **#TeamDon 🤝** comes in under it, posted
**DING** behind the glass: the silhouette lifts a glowing phone to its face. In the foreground Don still smiles
Pam sees the glow. Her mouth opens to warn him; she looks at Don posing; her cup comes up to her chin (her mouth stays visible for the bubble's tail)
shots.line: PAM (under her breath, into her cup): "Some pose. Others notice."

shots.picture: Red neon over the velvet booth: **THE HOUSE ALWAYS COLLECTS** (12's motto; lesson 148)

The #TeamDon photo. **A black, oily finger stops on Pam first** and leaves a print on her; then it slides across and spreads to zoom on **the heel** (a crop of 3.2: the same shoe, the same angle), **a second print right over the heel**

**The Client** in the velvet booth in his garage coveralls from 13, **filthy with oil**: oil to the elbows, a black smear on his cheek, the rag over his shoulder. He points at the phone. **Father** looks at it, then **nods once**; he doesn't look at the dirt. Bodyguard 1 does, wipes the phone on his sleeve, and sends. The Client sits back: **a black handprint on the velvet**; he checks his watch
Outside the glass: bodyguard 2's phone buzzes; he takes Sofía's CV from his breast pocket (from 12)
Her CV (the circled number, the lipstick phone); **a gold pen writes C-O-O-?** across the top, stroke by stroke (lesson 100)
A knock. The robot opens the door. Pam, on a step stool, is re-hanging the blind beside it. Sofía walks upstage to the door. Don in the right foreground, at the line, his back to all of it

**The office gag.** Don looks right at his own office door, DON · CEO, **across the tape**. A foot lifts and hovers over the line (held 0.6 s); he puts it back; he straightens his vest as if nothing happened
At the door: the CV into Sofía's hand, **COO?** up. Held
Pam on the stool in the foreground, the blind in her hands: **she saw COO?**. Beyond her, **Sofía steps across the tape** to Father's side
shots.line: PAM (under her breath): "Some draw lines. Others cross them."

shots.picture: Sofía, back across the line at the counter. Pam's phone lights up beside her hand: **INVITATION · DAD** (0.6 s on the screen inside the shot). She looks up, across the room, at Pam

Don alone in front, facing the camera, sincere. Behind him: **Pam's hand reaching across the line to her lit phone**, Mom turned away on the tape, **Sofía on Father's side, COO? in hand**, the robot at the cord. No glance, no realisation
The robot's hand yanks the cord: **the blinds shoot up**; **Don's hand comes in on the left cord** and grabs it (he is back at his cord, as in frame 0). Cut to 1.1
